system.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can spend 1 Scorch Charge, coat your hands or feet in scorching flames that only harms what you touch for the next minute. Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 2d6, deals fire damage, and if you score a critical hit while dealing [Unarmed Damage], the target gains 1 rank of Immolation.

Additionally, as an Action, by placing your hand against plant matter or something metallic, that is no larger than a 1-foot cube, you are able to reduce it to ash or a molten puddle by flash frying it.
